description: Immich photo server: ingress traffic, background job queues, repository (database/storage/ML) call timing and container resources. Job and repository metrics come from Immich's OpenTelemetry exporters (immich-api :8081, immich-microservices :8082); HTTP from Traefik because Immich's HTTP instrumentation exports nothing.

panels.title: API Worker
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the immich-api worker's OpenTelemetry exporter (:8081).

panels.title: Microservices Worker
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the immich-microservices worker (:8082), which runs the background job queues.

panels.title: Machine Learning
panels.description: Available replicas of the machine-learning deployment (Smart Search, face detection, OCR). It exports no metrics of its own.

panels.title: Users
panels.description: Immich user accounts (immich_users_total).

panels.title: Server Uptime
panels.description: Time since the immich-server container last started.

panels.title: Active Jobs
panels.description: Jobs currently being processed across all queues. Immich only exports per-queue active counts, not waiting/failed queue depth.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Container restarts in the immich namespace (server, machine-learning, valkey) over the selected range.

panels.title: Requests by Status
panels.description: Requests Traefik forwarded to Immich, by response code. Immich's own HTTP instrumentation exports nothing in this build, so the ingress is the only per-request source (no per-route breakdown). Code 0 is a WebSocket upgrade.

panels.title: Response Latency
panels.description: Traefik-measured response time for HTTP requests to Immich (WebSockets excluded). Large uploads/downloads and video streams inflate the upper quantiles.

panels.title: Error Ratio
panels.description: Share of Immich requests answered with 5xx (server errors) and 4xx (client/auth errors). Empty when there was no traffic.

panels.title: Upload / Download Throughput
panels.description: Request and response body bytes through Traefik.

panels.title: Active Jobs by Queue
panels.description: Jobs in progress per queue (immich_queues_<queue>_active). A queue's series only appears once it has run a job since the server started; waiting/delayed counts are not exported.

panels.title: Job Outcomes
panels.description: Finished jobs per second by result (immich_jobs_<job>_<status>_total). Series appear after the first job of that kind finishes.

panels.title: Jobs Processed by Type
panels.description: Jobs finished (success, skipped or failed) per job type over the selected range, from the job counters. Counters reset when the server restarts.

targets.expr: sum by (handler) (count_over_time({namespace="immich", pod=~"immich-server-.*"} |= "Unable to run job handler" | regexp `Unable to run job handler \((?P<handler>[A-Za-z]+)\)` [$__range]))

panels.title: Failed Jobs by Handler (logs)
panels.description: 'Unable to run job handler' errors per job type in the selected range, from the server log. Covers time before telemetry was enabled and survives restarts.

panels.title: Busy Time by Repository
panels.description: Seconds spent inside each repository's methods per second (both workers). Repositories wrap database queries, file storage, machine-learning calls and job-queue (Redis) operations; ~1 means one call in flight on average.

panels.title: Calls by Repository
panels.description: Repository method calls per second (both workers).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (repository, method) (increase(label_replace(label_replace({job=~"immich-.*", __name__=~"immich_.+_repository_.+_duration_sum"}, "repository", "$1", "__name__", "immich_(.+)_repository_.+_duration_sum"), "method", "$1", "__name__", "immich_.+_repository_(.+)_duration_sum")[$__range:1m])) / sum by (repository, method) (increase(label_replace(label_replace({job=~"immich-.*", __name__=~"immich_.+_repository_.+_duration_count"}, "repository", "$1", "__name__", "immich_(.+)_repository_.+_duration_count"), "method", "$1", "__name__", "immich_.+_repository_(.+)_duration_count")[$__range:1m])))

panels.title: Slowest Methods (mean)
panels.description: Mean duration per repository method over the selected range. Long-lived calls (locks, worker start-up, ML health ticks) legitimately rank high.

panels.title: Most Time Spent (total)
panels.description: Total time spent per repository method over the selected range: where database/storage time actually goes.

panels.title: Container Memory vs Limit
panels.description: Working-set memory per pod (server runs both workers; limit 3Gi) against its limit (machine-learning 2Gi; valkey has none). Machine-learning has no metrics endpoint, so this is cAdvisor only.

panels.title: Container CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used per pod. Only machine-learning has a CPU limit (0.6 cores); thumbnailing and video transcoding show up under server.

panels.title: Worker Process Memory
panels.description: Resident memory of each Node.js worker process inside the server container (host-metrics process_memory_usage). Immich exports no V8 heap or event-loop metrics.

panels.title: Worker Process CPU
panels.description: CPU seconds per second used by each worker process (user + system). External tools (ffmpeg, exiftool, vips threads) may not be fully attributed.

targets.expr: sum by (component) (label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="immich", container="main"}, "component", "$1", "pod", "immich-(.+)-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+")) / sum by (component) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="immich", resource="memory"}, "component", "$1", "pod", "immich-(.+)-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+"))

panels.title: Memory % of Limit
panels.description: Working set relative to the memory limit; the pod is OOM-killed at 100%.

panels.title: Volume Usage
panels.description: Used share of each Immich PVC (photo library, ML model cache, valkey).

panels.title: Server Errors and Warnings
panels.description: ERROR/WARN lines from the server (both workers), e.g. failed job handlers, missing files, ML connectivity.

title: Immich
